review_scope: Eight selected primary works/tools relevant to catalyst costing and decision normalization; not an exhaustive systematic review or a proof of priority.

nickel_case.source: Petel et al., Advanced Sustainable Systems 8, 2300030 (2024)
nickel_case.locator: Table 1, PDF page 3; price year in Catalyst Cost Estimation, PDF page 6
nickel_case.cost_evidence: Published modeled materials costs including reagents, workup solvents and silica support; 2016 USD. Uses CatCost, not industrial invoices.
nickel_case.exclusions: Gen 3 has no reported yield/cost. No precursor quotations, proprietary inputs, workbook data or performance/lifetime equivalence imported.

lifetime_case.classification: Published process-economic scenario; assumed turnover lifetime and prices, not a COMET catalyst-life measurement
lifetime_case.use: Context for excluding lifetime/productivity claims; no numeric lifetime calibration imported.

normalization_prior.use: Primary methodological context: weighted-sum rank reversal and normalization dependence predate COMET; no replacement ranking method adopted.
